lessons.objective_en: Greet people, respond politely and give simple yes/no answers.

lessons.title_de: Ich, du und wir: sein und haben
lessons.objective_en: Recognize basic personal pronouns and use the core forms of sein, haben and heißen.
Ask about people, things, places, origins, destinations, time and quantities.
Introduce your name, language, origin and place of residence.
Connect simple ideas, negate nouns or statements and express ability or wishes.
Give contact details, age and basic family or marital information.
Name close family members and distinguish generations.
Name friends and neighbours and describe helping, giving, bringing and fetching.
Recognize and say the numbers zero through nine.
Use common larger numbers and describe simple quantities.
Name the seven days of the week and locate events relative to today.

lessons.title_en: Clock time and times of day
lessons.objective_en: Identify time units and common times of day and describe early, late, and now.
Recognize the first ten Gregorian month names and their order.
Complete the month sequence and talk about the calendar and the four seasons.
Name ten common actions in a simple daily routine.
Name common rooms and basic parts of a home.
Identify common household furniture and essential appliances.
Recognize and name common fruit and vegetables when buying food.
Name basic foods and ingredients for everyday meals.
Name common drinks and containers and order a drink.
Ask about prices and express basic shopping needs.
Name common clothes and say what someone wears.
Identify basic colors and distinguish light and dark shades.
Recognize essential places and services in a town.
Understand simple directions and describe basic spatial relationships.
Name common transport and describe getting on and off.
Name classroom materials and basic reading and writing activities.
Use essential classroom communication words and describe responses.
Name workplaces, work relationships, and medical professions.
Name essential body parts for everyday health communication.
Describe common symptoms and ask for basic help.
Describe everyday weather and temperature.
Name interests and simple leisure activities.
Name digital devices and describe basic communication.
Name travel essentials and arrange a simple trip.
Name meals, express hunger and request the bill.
Express preferences, obligations and permission, and describe taking, waiting, staying and movement or position.
Describe and compare familiar objects using basic adjectives.
Describe basic feelings and friendly everyday interactions.
Arrange appointments, handle forms and understand opening or urgency.
